server: Web research tools for agents, built on Mastra and Jev (TypeSafe's decision model): search, read, crawl, extract, and watch web pages, with typed inputs and capped output. TYPESAFE_API_KEY lets Jev make the judgment calls; with no key, rules decide.
instructions: Call answer or research before replying to any question of fact, even one you think you know; never answer from memory. Example: asked who won the 2026 final, call answer with that question, then reply from its sources; if nothing is found, say unknown. For two or more URLs, call batch once, not scrape per URL. In a shell, the same tools run as webular answer, webular research, and webular batch. With TYPESAFE_API_KEY set, judgment calls go to Jev; without it, rules decide.

tools.search: Find pages across the web, Wikipedia, Hacker News, or arXiv. Use for facts that may be new or outside your memory. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.
tools.scrape: Read one web page as clean Markdown. Use for one URL; for two or more, use batch. Returns the title and Markdown.
tools.map: List a site's URLs from its sitemap and links. Use to see its pages first. Returns the URLs.
tools.summarize: Pick the key sentences of a text or page, with no model call. Use for a long text. Returns them verbatim with offsets.
tools.crawl: Visit a page and the pages it links to, to a depth and page limit. Use when one page is not enough. Returns each URL and its Markdown.
tools.extract: Get named parts of a page by CSS selector, like a price, as name:selector pairs or one selector. Use for known layouts. Returns the matched text.
tools.answer: Answer a question from live web sources. Use before replying to any question of fact; urls reads only those pages. Returns key sentences and source URLs.
tools.research: Research a topic across many sources in one call. Use when asked to research, not search then scrape. Returns key points with source URLs.
tools.jev: Improve webular's Jev calls: learn tests lessons; correct labels one recorded call (id) with the right answer (label). Use only to tune Jev.
tools.parse: Turn a local file, like a PDF or HTML file, into clean text. Use for a file on disk. Returns the text.
tools.media: Save a page's media to a file: download, screenshot, or PDF. Use for the file, not the text. Returns the path and size.
tools.monitor: Check a page for changes since the last check. Use to see what changed. Returns whether and what changed.
tools.batch: Read two or more URLs in one call. Use instead of one scrape per URL. Returns one result per URL.
tools.act: Read a page in a real browser. Use when a page needs JavaScript. Pass goal instead of url to act in the Cua window named by WEBULAR_CUA_WINDOW. Returns the page text, or status (done or infeasible), at (step not reached), and rungs (ax, ocr, pixel).
tools.feed: Read an RSS or Atom feed. Use for a site's newest posts. Returns each item's title, link, and date.
tools.doctor: Check that webular can run here. Use when a tool fails for no clear reason. Returns each check's result.
tools.tasks: List the mise tasks that build, check, and run webular. Use to learn how to run it. Returns task names and count.
tools.diagram: List the XState machines that model webular commands. Use to learn how a command flows. Returns names and count.
tools.audit: Check whether deepsec is installed and show the security scan plan, with no API key. Use for a security scan. Returns readiness and the command to run.

titles.answer: Answer a question from the web
titles.media: Save page media to a file
titles.act: Open a page in a browser
